column3: With respect to the Aura Hotel Times Square Mortgage Loan (4.3%), the guarantor (Joseph Moinian) or affiliated entities are involved in several open litigation matters, including the following: (i) Joseph Moinian was named as a co-defendant in an action filed in NY Supreme Court by American General Life Insurance Co. (“AGLIC”) in July 2025 related to the foreclosure of 500-512 7th Ave. in New York City. AGLIC has asserted springing recourse claims against the principals, including Joseh Moinian, due to the misappropriation of tenant security funds, ostensibly at the direction of the managing partner and majority owner, Chetrit. Joseph Moinian maintains that he had no knowledge of the misappropriation and that he derived no benefit from it. The litigation is in its discovery phase. (ii) Joseph Moinian was named as a co-defendant in an action filed in NY Supreme Court by Metropolitan Bank filed in January 2025 to enforce a guaranty on a loan made to David Moinian, Joseph Moinian’s brother. The plaintiff has filed a motion for summary judgment against the borrower and Joseph Moinian as guarantor, which the co-defendants have opposed. The Court’s ruling is pending. The claim is in excess of $5 million. (iii) Joseph Moinian was named a co-defendant in an action filed in NY Supreme Court in August 2020 by Atlantic Specialty Insurance Co. to enforce an appeal bond.
